name: Iron-bound chest
description: A heavy closed chest of dark stained planks, about 1 m wide, 0.7 m deep and 0.7 m high, with a low domed lid, wrapped in iron: an iron-shod plinth, hoops round the body, corner plates, studded straps over the lid, side ring handles and a round rusty lock plate on the front bearing a raised sigil, a ring round a five-pointed star, under a hasp.

provenance.prompt: A heavy dark chest wrapped in iron with a sigil lock plate, about 1 x 0.7 x 0.7 m, closed, front on -y.
